description: This file contains a Java class 'FineractClientDemo' that demonstrates the usage of the Fineract client library to connect to a Fineract API, retrieve staff data, and log the display name. It includes import statements, class definition, logging setup, and a method for demonstration.

classes.name: FineractClientDemo
classes.description: A demonstration class that shows how to instantiate the Fineract client, retrieve staff data, and log a staff member's display name.

methods.name: demoClient
methods.description: A method that builds a Fineract client, retrieves staff list data with specific parameters, and logs the display name of the first staff member.
